root_cause.text: The ath5k wireless driver performs an out-of-bounds array write in `ath5k_tx_frame_completed` because it sets a sentinel value at index `ts->ts_final_idx + 1` in the `rates` array without checking if the index exceeds the array's maximum size of `IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a bounds check `if (ts->ts_final_idx + 1 < IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES)` before writing to `info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx`, and the CVE description notes that `ts->ts_final_idx` can be 3, which results in an out-of-bounds index of 4 for the 4-element `rates` array.
